description: issue #689: bare `beep` (Sound profile, arity 0) schedules one short implementation-defined alert sound and emits exactly one `sound` event with payload {command:"beep"} - no arguments, no sound-state change, no errors. The runtime models sound as scheduling + event emission, never a real audio device, so this event is emitted unconditionally even in a muted environment (spec/interaction-events.md's `beep` section), keeping deterministic replay independent of audio availability.
